original_twelve.changes: New queue command and optional recording-only overview camera; learned actor, weights, thresholds, physics and task/wrist calibration unchanged.
original_twelve.primary_definition: Verified physical and visual grasp, bilateral contacts >=80% of tipping samples, >=1 nominal mL transferred, correct near-full/empty stop, >=90% final rim height or <=max(.25 nominal mL,1% initial) source, ordered completed upright return/release, no gates, zero final outside liquid and zero sampled near-table loss.

additional_two.changes: Only extra layout queue command; actor and all camera/physics code unchanged from original twelve.
additional_two.primary_definition: Verified physical and visual grasp, bilateral contacts >=80% of tipping samples, >=1 nominal mL transferred, correct near-full/empty stop, >=90% final rim height or <=max(.25 nominal mL,1% initial) source, ordered completed upright return/release, no gates, zero final outside liquid and zero sampled near-table loss.

primary_definition: Verified physical and visual grasp, bilateral contacts >=80% of tipping samples, >=1 nominal mL transferred, correct near-full/empty stop, >=90% final rim height or <=max(.25 nominal mL,1% initial) source, ordered completed upright return/release, no gates, zero final outside liquid and zero sampled near-table loss.
scope: Fourteen deliberately chosen layouts with five exact swaps; eleven starts without the initial geometry/contact flags. Same learned actor and checkpoint, no retraining. All original twelve plus both supplements retained; not iid success-rate evidence.
setup_note: Post-hoc full-hand geometry flags original02/03/08. Native bottle/finger contact is recorded separately; cup contact in03 was not instrumented. Two full-hand-screened additional layouts ensure at least ten unflagged starts without deleting the initial failures.
note: PASS means the strict full task. No-pour zero-loss aborts are failures. Material A;400Hz physics and20Hz observations; nominal mL is particle-count based, not calibrated physical volume.
